mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, email, password_hash, name, phone, status) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{phone}, 'ACTIVE')

INSERT INTO technician_profile (id, user_id, approval_status, active) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler}, #{userId,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler}, 'PENDING', false)
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, name, phone, status, auth_version FROM app_user WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email}) AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, email, password_hash, name, phone, status, auth_version FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, email, password_hash, name, phone, status, auth_version FROM app_user WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM app_user WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE app_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE app_user SET auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT role_code FROM user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} ORDER BY role_code
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET status = #{status}, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND auth_version = #{authVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL )
